top_signals.title: Citi Says European Economic Data, Earnings Going in 'Right Direction'
top_signals.summary: Beata Manthey, European equity strategy head at Citi, says economic data, earnings revisions and government policy paint a positive picture for European firms. "We argue that actually policymakers are making good steps toward really protecting [the] European economy going forward," Manthey tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: European Stocks Muted Before US Data; VW Soars on Restructuring
top_signals.summary: European stocks posted muted moves as investors prepared for key US jobs numbers that will provide clues on the chances of a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month. Volkswagen AG shares jumped on plans for a sweeping restructuring at the carmaker.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Mantle adds Paxos’ USDG stablecoin, joins Global Dollar Network
top_signals.summary: Mantle has added Paxos-issued USDG as a natively minted stablecoin while joining the network’s reward-sharing structure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: India’s Billionaires Are Fighting Over Crumbs
top_signals.summary: Feuds among India’s corporate elite are not new, but when so many billionaires are involved, it's time to pay attention, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Andy Mukherjee explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
